scope: Independent read-only data/provenance audit. Only DATA_AUDIT.json written; no plot data, graph, production/history edit or new long-running job.

i_timing_v3_excluded.reason: Not the adopted i design; its cycle counts must not be used.

shake.drbg_scope: Existing independent DRBG replay summary reused; this audit rechecks cfg/replay record plus complete original KAT signature bytes, without launching crypto code.
shake.job_port_encoding: Canonical byte strings are packed little-endian into low128 bits of256-bit RTL ports, matching model.vectors little-endian job.mem serialization and the profiling C++ node loader.

sha2.drbg_scope: Existing independent DRBG replay summary reused; this audit rechecks cfg/replay record plus complete original KAT signature bytes, without launching crypto code.
sha2.job_port_encoding: Canonical byte strings are packed little-endian into low128 bits of256-bit RTL ports, matching model.vectors little-endian job.mem serialization and the profiling C++ node loader.

partition_rules.project_hash: Keccak scalar round_update only; SHA256 !stalled && stage0.source_valid round advance, plus !stalled && finished feed-forward. Other formatter/control cycles remain Remaining.
partition_rules.project_transfer: 0: no Hash-MMIO interface. Internal ready/valid handoff is an overlapping diagnostic, never an extra stacked Transfer category.
partition_rules.sloth_hash: Published active engine clocks: SHAKE includes Keccak rounds/internal chain advancement; SHA2 includes load, chain padding, PRF setup, 64 rounds and feed-forward.
partition_rules.sloth_transfer: Hash-exclusive Hash-MMIO bus occupancy; not whole MMIO instruction execution; overlapping cycles have Hash priority.
partition_rules.remaining: Operation total minus disjoint Hash and Transfer; includes control, formatting, memory and internal data movement. It is not pure input assembly or pure CPU wait.
partition_rules.project_window: Production active Sign counter including FINISH, excluding common boot and post-Sign signature-cache readback.
partition_rules.sloth_window: Function-entry instruction through before return-address instruction; excludes framework, checksum generation and tamper replay.

limitations: Historical SLotH report correctness is KAT private-key/signature+message checksum, normal verify and tamper rejection. This audit does not collect a new full SLotH runtime signature stream; every local signature/cache and fixture is independently byte-equal to the original SLotH .rsp.1 signature.
SLOTH Hash scope includes in-engine load/control that is Remaining in the project. Preserve this boundary caveat; do not reclassify project control to enlarge a figure difference.
Fresh c metrics must replace old c Remaining423350/466771. Only current c_control_pipeline33B metrics555546/598967 are approved.
Default1B regression cycles and i_timing_v3 counts are excluded. Each approved local input job explicitly contains33 message bytes and expectedKAT file hashes match.
Clock counts alone establish no frequency, area, ATP or board timing comparison.
